heroHeadline: CRISPR Prime Editing Rewrites DNA Inside the Human Body for the First Time
heroSubtitle: October 29, 2026: SingularityHub reports prime editing has been used in vivo in a human for the first time, a step beyond standard CRISPR cutting and base editing.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
